title: Imminent names BAE Systems as an inheritor of UFO technology

tellings.quote: >> Lou's book revealed a ton. And it also if you read imminent his book, he talks about BAE Systems as one of the companies that inherited, you know, UFO technology.

plain: The defense company BAE Systems is named as one of the companies that "inherited" UFO technology, according to Michels' account of Imminent, a 2024 book by a man named Luis Elizondo, whom he calls Lou. Michels says the book "revealed a ton" and gives this as one of its claims. If true, it would mean technology from UFOs ended up with a private firm.
